name: predict_admet_properties
description: Predict the ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity) properties of a molecule based on its SMILES (Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System) string. Use this tool when you need to evaluate the pharmacokinetic and toxicological profile of a specific molecule. Do NOT use this tool for predicting properties of mixtures or non-organic compounds; for those cases, consider using a different cheminformatics tool.

parameters.name: smiles
parameters.description: The SMILES representation of the molecule. Must be a valid SMILES string that accurately describes the molecular structure. There are no strict length limits, but it should be a reasonable representation of a molecule.

parameters.name: include_toxicity
parameters.description: Whether to include predicted toxicity properties in the response. Set to false if only ADMET properties are needed without toxicity information. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: model_type
parameters.description: The type of predictive model to use for the ADMET properties. Must be one of: 'default', 'advanced'. 'default' uses standard algorithms, while 'advanced' employs more complex models for potentially better accuracy. Defaults to 'default'.

absorption.description: Predicted absorption value (0-1), where 1 indicates high absorption and 0 indicates low absorption.

distribution.description: Predicted distribution value (0-1), indicating how well the molecule distributes in the body.

metabolism.description: Predicted metabolism rate (0-1), where higher values indicate faster metabolism.

excretion.description: Predicted excretion rate (0-1), indicating how quickly the molecule is eliminated from the body.

toxicity.description: Predicted toxicity level (0-1), where higher values indicate greater potential toxicity. Only present if include_toxicity is true.

return_schema.description: ADMET property predictions including absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and optional toxicity.
